acs.text: Given the extensions `fenced_code` and `attr_list` and the source "``` { .python linenums }\nprint(1)\n```", when the source is converted, then no exception is raised and the output contains `<pre><code class="language-python"` and `print(1)`.

Given the extensions `fenced_code` and `attr_list` and the source "``` { .python linenums=\"true\" }\nprint(1)\n```", when the source is converted, then no exception is raised and the output contains `<pre><code class="language-python"` and `print(1)`.

Given the extensions `fenced_code` and `attr_list` and the source "``` { .python } print(1) ```", when the source is converted, then the output is exactly `
print(1)
`.

Given the extensions `fenced_code` and `attr_list` and the source "``` { .python data-x="1" } print(1) ```", when the source is converted, then the output is exactly `
print(1)
`.

Given the extensions `fenced_code` and `attr_list` and the source "``` { data-test="{}" } # Some python code ```", when the source is converted, then the output is exactly `
# Some python code
`.

Given the extensions `fenced_code`, `attr_list` and `codehilite`, and the source "``` { .python linenums=\"true\" }\nprint(1)\n```", when the source is converted, then no exception is raised and the output contains `codehilite`.

Given the extensions `fenced_code`, `attr_list` and `codehilite`, and the source "``` { .python linenums=True }\n# Some python code\n```", when the source is converted, then no exception is raised and the output contains `codehilite` and `# Some python code`.

questions.title: What happens to the attribute in the output?
questions.question: When `linenums`, `guess_lang` or `noclasses` is on a fenced block and `codehilite` is not enabled, what shall the output contain for that attribute?
questions.options:
(a) omit the attribute: `
print(1)\n
` (b) keep it with the value as written, for example `linenums="true"` (c) keep it with a normalised value, for example `linenums="linenums"` for a valueless flag (d) Other
